reviews.author: Jim Freiberger
reviews.text: I appreciate the service I have received at A-1. They have done simple to complex work at fair prices and the repairs have been solid. The owner, Marcos, is always accessible. However, sometimes he’s a little optimistic regarding time, but I get it things happen - parts shipments get delayed or unexpected technical problems come up. But they have consistently completed the job and communicated well. It’s been a very good experience taking cars to A-1 and I recommend them.

reviews.author: steven mabe
reviews.text: Called Andrew and discussed issue with my boat engine. He was very knowledgeable and gave me advice on how to fix myself to avoid a service call. Advice worked and will definitely utilize his services in the future when I need on site boat repairs. Nice to talk to a mechanic to knows his trade.

reviews.author: Melissa Jones
reviews.text: Very friendly, knowledgeable they know what they are doing when it comes to trucks!! They fixed my husband's truck in a timely manner, it had some wiring problems and the o2 sensor , check engine light were staying on. I would definitely recommend them to anyone. Thank you for a job well done!

reviews.author: Amelia Lovelace
reviews.text: I got stranded in Mocksville with a busted transmission. A-1 Auto repair called me a tow and had my car looked at the very same day. They put in the extra hours working until 10pm to replace my transmission so that I could be back on the road as soon as possible. They provided me with shuttle service to the place I was staying. They are so nice and understanding and I am grateful to them for helping me out. I never felt pressured by them during my decision. I could not be more pleased with the job they did.

reviews.author: Matt King
reviews.text: Marcus was excellent to speak with. He replaced my fuel pump for me. Great price, fast work. I don't give 5 stars usually, but a1 deserves 10. Thank you, and I'll be doing business with you again.

reviews.author: Pattie Foster
reviews.text: My check engine light was on. They found that a small clip had been left off after a repair at the dealership. Clip was replaced promptly at a very reasonable price. Great service. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Tracy Stell
reviews.text: Car developed a bad sound on the way to a family reunion. We were halfway between home and the mountains. Lucky enough to find this shop open on a Saturday. Great and super nice folks. I would recommend them to anyone and everyone. Awesome service! Ended up being a minor repair and we made the reunion. Saved us an uber and rental. A-1 is A-1.

reviews.author: Jason Cloer
reviews.text: Good guys, they hooked my girls car up. Did spark plugs, both wheel hubs, brakes, for a fair price. Great work and cheaper than the dealership. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Bethany Martin
reviews.text: My alternator went out on my way back to Knoxville and I had my car towed here for repairs. They could have delayed or ripped me off; instead they worked quickly and at a very good price. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Bryan Hathaway
reviews.text: I wanted to buy a 4Runner out of town and needed a mechanic to check it out to make sure it was worth flying down from Michigan so I called these guys and they fit me in their schedule. They caught a wheel bearing going out saving me time and money. Good people, definitely go through these guys for anything.

reviews.author: Glenn Stapleton
reviews.text: Awesome shop, these guys got my 2005 H2 Hummer back on the road; replacing the transmission and fixing several other things, that I was not aware of, having just bought the car about a month ago, that could have turned into major issues on my cross country move back to California. Thank you very much.

reviews.author: Sheri Hackart
reviews.text: Customer Service = no service. We have called 4 times and now we give up. 1st time left a message no return call. 2nd time they were at lunch this was at 2pm said they were on lunch break and would call back. 3rd time person said they were still on break and would call back. 4th time today they said they were not near a computer and would have to call back. that was 4 hours ago. Dont know how they got good reviews because it is impossible to get anyone to call you to even get an appointment.

reviews.author: Connie Williams
reviews.text: The staff is very helpful. They will even show you on the vehicle where the repair is needed so you truly understand. Greatful for them working on my truck before traveling long distance with my children.

reviews.author: Dave Musser
reviews.text: A 1 auto got us back on the road in less than hour. We pulled up w a leaking pinion seal. The price was right, and great people. So great cause we were far from home. Thanks A1. Dave Musser and Sisily Neitz.

reviews.author: Ed Conway
reviews.text: Was traveling and an hour away from home. Marcus was honest, fair & easy to work with, that's all you can ask for from a mechanic! Highly recommended

reviews.author: Stephen Horney
reviews.text: Van started shaking, while in Taco Bell drive thru. Pulled across the road to AT Auto Repair, and Marcus took care of it right away. We were low on oil and almost locked it up. Thanks to A1 Auto Repair we are rolling again. .

reviews.author: Mike MD
reviews.text: These guys looked over a used car I was going to purchase recently with zero notice to bring it to their shop. They gave me good advice and peace of mind about the vehicle I was going to purchase. Thanks guys

reviews.author: Emma Lee (Emmy)
reviews.text: Did everything they possibly could to fix our 2000 Ford Windstar. They were very easy to work with. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Daniel Parker
reviews.text: Never go anywhere else to have my car worked on. Marcus the owner is a great down to earth guy, and he really knows what he is doing!

reviews.author: Kathy Reavis
reviews.text: When take your stuff down to get worked on you might get it back in one piece. They jump from car to another car and then maybe back to your or maybe another car. They have to much going on at one time

reviews.author: TW Hutch
reviews.text: Marcus and crew run a tight ship. You don't need to worry about price gouging here, they take very good care of your vehicle and you.

reviews.author: Joseph Giarrusso
reviews.text: I was out of state and had issues with my truck on the highway close by and the guys at A-1 Auto immediately got to work and got me back on the road with grade A repairs. I'd rate 10 stars if I could.

reviews.author: No One
reviews.text: Great fast service...will never go anywhere else..honest and no b.s. like others. Having been using for a long time

reviews.author: Johnathan Long
reviews.text: Staff was very friendly and helpful. I would not hesitate to revisit or refer a friend to this business.

reviews.author: Tyler Wylie
reviews.text: I had my car here for four days and was charged $350 for an A/C recharge and what they said was a small leak. Less than two weeks later, the A/C was blowing hot air again. On top of that, they never put the high- and low-side A/C service caps back on. I called and asked them to recheck the car and replace the missing caps. They kept my car for another three days. After multiple attempts to get an update, I was told they “didn’t know” what the problem was and that it might require removing the entire dashboard to look for another leak. To make matters worse, they still didn’t reinstall the A/C caps and asked me to come back the next day just so they could put them on. Overall, the service, communication, and attention to detail were very disappointing. The staff was unfriendly, the waiting room was dirty, and after a week of having my car between two visits, the original problem still wasn’t fixed. I’d recommend taking your business somewhere else if you want to avoid the frustration.

reviews.author: Fresota
reviews.text: They are very professional in their work. Excellent service. And I am very satisfied with the work done on my car. I really like that they always address the root of the problem to provide a proper solution.
